Titel: Regulatory Affairs CMC Specialist (all genders) - Contract

Abgerufen am: 23.09.2026 07:31

About the job
Rheinknie Biologics is a clinical-stage biotech company developing monoclonal antibodies for autoimmune diseases. Our lead asset is preparing for BLA/MAA submission in 2027.

For our Regulatory CMC team we are looking for an experienced contractor for 12 months.

Key Responsibilities
• Author and review CMC sections (Module 3, Quality Overall Summary) for IND/IMPD and BLA/MAA submissions
• Prepare responses to health authority questions (FDA, EMA, Swissmedic)
• Assess change controls for regulatory impact and define the filing strategy (variations, annual reports)
• Coordinate with CMOs and internal Technical Development, QA and Supply teams
• Maintain regulatory information in Veeva Vault RIM

Qualifications
• MSc or PhD in life sciences, pharmacy or chemistry
• Min. 5 years in Regulatory Affairs CMC for biologics
• Hands-on experience with eCTD Module 3 authoring and lifecycle management
• Good understanding of GMP and ICH Q8-Q12
• Excellent written English, German or French is a plus

Contract details
• Contract via our staffing partner, 12 months, 100% FTE
• On-site in Basel min. 4 days/week (1 day home office), no full remote possible
• Rate: CHF 120 - 140 per hour, depending on experience
• Candidates must hold a valid Swiss work permit or EU/EFTA citizenship

Seniority level
Mid-Senior level
Employment type
Contract
Job function
Quality Assurance
Industries
Biotechnology Research
